symbols.name: number of axes
symbols.meaning: The number of axes of the array.
symbols.quote: Let $D$ be the number of axes.

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: The index of one axis, running from 1 to D.
symbols.quote: Let $\mu$ be the index of one axis, $1 \le \mu \le D$.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of values the coordinate along axis mu takes.
symbols.quote: Let $\theta_\mu$ be the length of axis $\mu$, the number of values its coordinate takes.

symbols.name: axis coordinate
symbols.meaning: The coordinate of an address along axis mu, an integer from 0 to theta_mu minus 1.
symbols.quote: Let $\xi_\mu$ be the coordinate of an address along axis $\mu$, so $0 \le \xi_\mu < \theta_\mu$.

symbols.name: coefficient count
symbols.meaning: The number of complex coefficients in one stored polynomial, a power of two.
symbols.quote: Let $P$ be the number of complex coefficients in one stored polynomial, a power of two.

symbols.name: stored coefficient
symbols.meaning: The coefficient of y to the power k in the stored polynomial.
symbols.quote: Modulo $y^P+1$ means $y^P$ is replaced by $-1$, so the stored form is $\phi_0+\phi_1y+\dots+\phi_{P-1}y^{P-1}$, where $\phi_k$ is the coefficient of $y^k$.

symbols.name: transform length
symbols.meaning: A power of two, at least 2, that divides 2P and is the length of a transform axis.
symbols.quote: Let $\varrho \ge 2$ be a power of two dividing $2P$, the length of a transform axis.

symbols.name: axis root
symbols.meaning: The root of unity y to the power 2P divided by rho, which has order rho.
symbols.quote: Let $\zeta=y^{2P/\varrho}$, a root of unity of order $\varrho$.

relations.quote: Along each axis the array is acted on by a [Discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md) of length $\theta_\mu$.
On the remaining axes the transform weights its entries by powers of $y$, each a [Root of unity](root-of-unity.md).
